files.reason: Package entry of the controlled Self-Builder; states in one place what it is (a template-based, validated, tested, versioned, reversible internal builder) and what it is not (no code-generating model, no external AI).

The build / rollback / disable pipeline: request -> analyze -> check capabilities -> identify gap -> plan -> generate -> validate -> test -> [analyze failure -> safe repair -> retest] -> checkpoint -> apply -> persist -> register -> version -> audit, with a checkpoint before anything is promoted and nothing activated on failure.
Stable machine-readable error codes used by the failure analyzer, the audit log and the tests.

Own tokenizer and recursive-descent parser/evaluator for the closed arithmetic expression language of the 'formula' archetype (user text is never given to eval/exec/compile; names must start with a letter).
Deterministic Persian text helpers (letters, digits, ZWNJ, punctuation, tokenization) shared by the request parser, the matcher and the Persian brain.
The only names a generated module is allowed to call (pure helpers bound into the sandbox namespace).
Integrity verification, manifest and start-up reconciliation after a restart or crash: verify active versions, quarantine (never delete) damaged files, fall back to the newest healthy older version.
Crash-proof workspace lock (SQLite BEGIN EXCLUSIVE) that works between threads, services and processes and is released by the OS when the holder dies.
Invocation matching: turns an ordinary Persian sentence into a call of a registered capability (derived from the capability records) and recognises questions about the registry.
Total math primitives shared by generated modules and the independent reference evaluator used by the differential tests.

Mirrors every applied build / rollback into the older capabilities / upgrades / versions tables of memory.db so the existing registries and the AEL UPGRADE / ROLLBACK statements keep telling the truth.
The single place for allowlists (archetypes, permissions, operations, directories, file patterns) and every resource limit.
Persistent capability registry (capabilities, versions, usage, feedback), answered from SQLite only.
Failure classification by stable code and a bounded list of safe repairs; repairs that change meaning ('guess') always need confirmation.
Deterministic Persian build-request analysis (fixed grammar over closed word lists): ready / clarify / unsupported / not a request.

Loads ONE validated generated module from verified bytes (empty __builtins__, never in sys.modules, no bytecode caches, soft per-call time budget, finite checked results) and runs test suites and capability calls against it.

Lazy facade the application talks to: owns files_dir/data/self_builder, opens and reconciles once per process, exposes build / rollback / disable / invoke / history / self_check; nothing is created on disk before build().
Capability spec (JSON, never executed): validation, fingerprinting and the difference between two versions.
SQLite store (WAL) with numbered migrations, transactions and a hash-chained audit log.
Instantiates a validated spec into one generated module plus a JSON differential test suite whose expected values come from an independent reference path.
The closed set of reviewed text operations the 'text_tool' archetype can compose.
Closed unit table with exact rational factors and the Persian / Latin names people actually type.
AST allowlist every generated module must pass before it is loaded (and each time it is loaded again).
The only place files are touched: atomic writes, Policy.resolve on every path, quarantine instead of delete.
Package entry; exposes dynamic_skill(memory, text), the single seam through which SkillSystem reaches the brain.
Scope selection (full / capabilities / off): application runtime, STANDALONE_AI_PERSIAN_BRAIN, explicit enable / disable.
PersianBrain coordinator: normalization -> intent -> handler -> fixed templates; capability flows (build, clarify, confirm, use, improve, roll back, disable) against the real registry and memory.
Dialogue state persisted in memory.db (persian_brain.dialogue.v1) with a TTL and validation of damaged state.
Intent classification (greeting, question, request, command, statement, teaching, continuation, reference, feedback, unknown) over closed word lists.
The small closed word lists the classifier compares tokens against.
Persian message templates built from facts that are true at that moment (no sentence -> answer table).
One canonical Persian normalization on top of the project's own Persian NLU.

The Claude Exit audit: the real android_entry in three SIGKILLed subprocesses (missing capability -> built -> persisted -> usable after restart -> improved -> rolled back -> tampering detected), no network / subprocess activity, pinned files byte-identical; plus the check that the documentation still matches the code.
